credits.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
credits.overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

credits.title: Savage Hunt
credits.overview: A vengeful tracker is brought in to hunt down a large grizzly bear that starts attacking humans once a new Montana resort begins being built.

credits.title: Burner
credits.overview: Ex-con single mom Kiki rebuilds her life and regains custody of her teen daughter, until her violent drug-dealer ex returns. To protect herself and her daughter, she must eliminate him without getting caught.

credits.title: High Ground
credits.overview: When a mysterious prisoner lands in jail, a border town sheriff faces the wrath of a brutal cartel.

credits.title: The Last Supper
credits.overview: In the days leading to betrayal, a gathering of disciples unravels into a web of secrets and hidden motives. As tensions simmer beneath the surface, trust is tested, and loyalty is questioned. The Last Supper becomes a night where nothing is as it seems, and every glance hides a deeper truth.

credits.title: 5lbs of Pressure
credits.overview: Fresh out of prison after serving time for murder, Adam returns to his old stomping grounds to seek out a son who doesn't know him. Eli, the brother of the man he killed is looking for revenge. Mike, is trying to escape a life of crime living under the thumb of his gangster Uncle.

credits.title: Fortunes of War
credits.overview: When a covert raid in Normandy goes wrong, a small team of British commandos are cut off from their comrades. Holed up in a barn and surrounded by Wehrmacht forces, their chances of survival appear bleak, until an unexpected discovery provides an opportunity to escape.

credits.title: One Ranger
credits.overview: A Texas Ranger is recruited by British Intelligence to track down a dangerous terrorist and stop him from attacking London.

credits.title: The Three Musketeers
credits.overview: France is in turmoil and a new, naive King finds himself manipulated by the evil Cardinal Richelieu. With a corrupt commander of the royal guard by his side the Cardinal employs the expertise of the devious and wicked Milady de Winter in a plot to bring down the monarchy and drag the country into war. credits.title: Zero
credits.overview: After a mysterious electro-magnetic pulse renders the world's technology useless, a young girl finds herself isolated and alone with only her father's strict set of rules to keep her alive.

credits.title: Robin Hood: The Rebellion
credits.overview: With his true love captured by the villainous Sheriff of Nottingham, the legendary Robin Hood and his crew of outlaws execute a daring rescue to save her.

credits.title: Burn Country
credits.overview: A former war journalist now writing for a paper in Northern California is drawn into conflict at home.

credits.title: Dementamania
credits.overview: A frustrated office worker finds himself caught between the realms of his deranged imagination and the mundane reality of his everyday existence.

credits.title: Little Deaths
credits.overview: Composed of three disturbingly sensual and terrifying short narratives, unified by the twin themes of sex and death.
